rows.name: Culkeeragh
rows.description: Bright light East side of entrance

rows.name: Boom Hall
rows.description: One fixed bright light

rows.name: Rosse Bay
rows.description: One fixed bright light

rows.name: Rock Mill
rows.description: One fixed red light, near the mill

rows.name: INNISTRAHULL
rows.character: One br. rev. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: A white tower, 41 ft. high; on N.E. part of island

rows.name: Dunree Head
rows.description: Shown from a dwelling-house, visible betw. N.N.E. ½ E. and S. ¼ E.

rows.name: Buncrana Pier
rows.description: From pillar on pier extremity, betw. N. by W. ½ W. and W. by S. ½ S.

rows.name: Fannet Point
rows.description: Tower, 26 ft. high; light red seaward; bright towards the Lough

rows.name: TORY ISLAND
rows.description: White tower, 87 ft. high, on the N.W. point of island. Obscured by island to S.S.E.

rows.name: ARANMORE ISLAND
rows.character: One rev. red and br. lt. Lower red light
rows.description: Tower, 76 ft. high, on Rinawros Pt. Lt. shows altern. red & br. flashes (of equal intensity) ev. 20 secs. Lower lt. red to eastward over Stag Rocks, betw. N.E. by E. ½ E. & E. by N.

rows.name: RATHLIN-O-BIRNE
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: Tower, 65 ft. high, on W. side. Lt. is bright seaward from N.E. ½ N. to S.S.E. ½ E. Red towards mainland and sound

rows.name: St. John's Point
rows.description: White tower, 47 ft. high. One bright fixed lt.

rows.name: Rotten Island
rows.description: One br. fix. lt., with red sector, over Bullockmore Rk., betw. S.W. ¾ S. & S.W. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Black Rock
rows.description: One fixed bright light in the bay

rows.name: Oyster Island
rows.description: Two fixed bright lights; in one, S.S.E. ¾ E.

rows.name: Broadhaven
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: On Gubacashel Point. White to seaward; red towards West side of harbour

rows.name: EAGLE ISLAND
rows.description: White towers, 87 and 64 ft. high. In one, E. by N. and W. by S., 132 yds. apart, clears all rocks off Black Sod Bay and Broadhaven

rows.name: BLACK ROCK
rows.description: Tower, 50 ft. high, on W. extremity of Black Rock; red toward land, from N.E. by E. ½ E. to S.E. by E. ½ E.

rows.name: Black Sod Quay
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: On Blacksod Point. Light bright, but red between S.W. by W. and S.W. ¾ S.

rows.name: CLARE ISLAND
rows.description: On North Point

rows.name: INISHGORT ISLAND
rows.description: One fixed bright light

rows.name: SLYNE HEAD
rows.character: One rev. light, 2 min. One fixed bright lt.
rows.description: On Illaunimmul Island. N. light-tower, 79 ft. high. Lt. rev.; once red, and twice bright. S. light-tower, 79 ft. high; fixed light. In one, N. ¾ E., 142 yds. apart, lead outside of rocks
